_doc: Bundle size budgets for the studio app. Sums files under each `path`
(optionally filtered by include/exclude substrings) and fails CI if
the bucket exceeds maxBytes. Numbers are uncompressed on-disk sizes —
switch to gzip via size-limit if/when that's worth the extra dep.
When a bucket goes red: either shrink the bundle (preferred) or bump
the threshold here with a rationale in the PR description. Don't
silently increase budgets without flagging why.
